title: ObjectUserBody: a constant mass matrix, computed once and stored
author: Claude-JG
description: A flag for a constant mass matrix, with a local storage of the matrix as in the ANCF elements: computed once, reused, recomputed after a change of a parameter or Assemble; useful for finite elements.
releaseNotes: ObjectUserBody has constantMassMatrix: its massMatrixUserFunction is called once, the result is kept and reused, computed again after a change of a parameter or Assemble, and the solvers treat the mass matrix as constant (revision2026c step RG7.12.5)
